Hello, I would like to report a problem with Barka Tunnel.

Your Barka Tunnel home
Home shows your IP, selected profile, VPN state and remaining access. Use the blue menu for subscriptions, IP Finder, help and support.

Before connecting
Enable Internet, select a suitable profile and check your access. Initial setup requires server synchronization. A matching IP alone does not guarantee a working VPN server.

Select a profile
Tap the network card and select the profile for your connection: MOOV-AFRICA BF, MOOV FORFAIT TIKTOK, ORANGE BF, TELECEL BF or GLOBAL MONDIAL.

Maintenance
Grey profiles cannot be selected. Tapping one displays a maintenance message. Wait for the service to return and synchronize.

Switch safely
Disconnect the VPN before changing profiles. IP rules depend on the profile; use the built-in Orange criteria in IP Finder.

Prepare
Disable Wi-Fi, enable mobile data and select Barka Tunnel as the Android digital assistant. Allow notifications for sound and vibration.

Choose criteria
Orange rules are built in. Other patterns support ^ prefix, $ suffix and = exact matching. Separate patterns with commas, semicolons or new lines.

Search in the background
Tap FIND AN IP. You can switch screens or apps; the search continues with a notification and Stop action. The active VPN is disconnected first. Airplane-mode cycles briefly interrupt mobile data and may interrupt calls or downloads.

Completion alert
A matching IP stops the search and triggers sound and vibration both inside and outside the app. Silent mode, Do Not Disturb and notification settings may restrict alerts. Return home to connect the VPN.

Stop or open settings
Use STOP in the app or notification. The gear beside the IP opens network settings without changing them. Android force-stop or manufacturer restrictions may stop the service; check the network before restarting.

Choose an offer
Open SUBSCRIPTION and select a duration. Active promotions show a countdown and automatically return to the regular price when they expire.

Pay securely
Tap PAY and complete the payment provider steps. Check the amount before confirming. If prices change, refresh the offer. Payments already started keep their original quoted amount.

Automatic activation
Once the server confirms payment, access activates on the associated phone without copying a code or tapping Activate. Return online to refresh TIME REMAINING.

Pending payment
Avoid paying twice. Reopen the app to resume checking. Contact support with the payment reference if needed, never your password.

When to use this
In-app purchases activate automatically. This screen is for codes received separately from a reseller or support, including 2, 3 and 6 hour test codes.

Activate
Open ACTIVATION CODE, paste the full code and tap ACTIVATE while online. Check TIME REMAINING.

Keep it private
Individual codes are tied to the activating device. Do not share them. For a rejected code, check the spelling and contact its issuer.

Connect
Select an available profile, check remaining access, tap the centre button and accept the Android VPN prompt if shown. Wait for CONNECTED before browsing.

Disconnect
Use the centre button or VPN notification. Disconnect before changing networks.

Save energy
Background display timers stop and diagnostics are spaced out. Auto Ping can be disabled in Settings. Stop IP searches and speed tests when finished. Weak signal, heavy traffic, encryption and charging can still generate heat.

Troubleshoot
Check Internet, maintenance and access. Review Journal after one complete attempt and share only relevant entries without secrets.

Events
Journal shows connection attempts, errors and confirmations. Orange means in progress, green success and red failure.

Auto Ping
Optional diagnostics run periodically, less often with screen off or battery saver. A single failed probe does not necessarily mean the VPN is broken.

Get help
Note the profile and time. Share relevant entries without passwords, UUIDs or personal codes. Clearing Journal does not change your subscription.

Customize
Choose language and theme without changing VPN profiles. Auto Ping enables optional tunnel diagnostics.

Tools
Settings provides VPN sharing, speed testing, data usage, update checks and app link sharing. See the following sections for details.

Stay in touch
Telegram Channel opens the community. Telegram Bot opens rhaffshopbot. Shop opens the website. CONTACT in Support opens WhatsApp. Suggestions accepts feedback when enabled.

Version
ABOUT shows the installed version. Android permissions remain under your control.
